name: Encrypted vault persists
description: Create a vault and persist its encrypted name across reloads.
steps: Open the app and press 新しい保管庫を作る.
Wait for 保管庫を作成しました and open 接続コードを表示.
Verify a 43-character code exists. Set 保管庫の名前 to QA保存構成 and press 名前を保存.
Wait for 保存しました and reload this page.
Verify the name is QA保存構成 after reconnection.
expected: The named vault is restored from encrypted database storage after page reload.

name: Second device sees changes
description: Connect an independent browser context with the recovery code and observe an update.
steps: Create a new vault and copy the code from 接続コードを表示.
Open an independent browser context, enter this code under 接続コード and press 接続する.
In the first context set 保管庫の名前 to 二台目にも表示 and press 名前を保存.
In the second context press 最新の内容を読む.
expected: The second context displays 二台目にも表示, proving durable cross-client data delivery.

name: Invalid connection rejected
description: A random code cannot read an existing vault.
steps: Enter AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA into 接続コード and press 接続する.
expected: The user sees 接続できません and no connected vault or private data is displayed.

name: Revoked code stops access
description: Revoke the vault and verify its former code cannot reconnect.
steps: Create a new vault and copy its connection code.
Press 保管庫を無効化する, then press もう一度押して全端末の接続を無効にする.
Wait for 保管庫を無効化しました.
Enter the copied code in 接続コード and press 接続する.
expected: Reconnection is rejected and no encrypted vault data is available with the revoked code.
